ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the diagram there are four small latitude-longitude grid diagrams, A, B, C, and D. D is located on the far right; the meridians are marked at about 85°E and 90°E, and the parallels are marked at about 45°N and 50°N, so the approximate range of region D is 85°E—90°E, 45°N—50°N. Reasoning: This latitude-longitude position corresponds to the inland northwest of China, near northern Xinjiang, belonging to arid and semi-arid regions, and agricultural development mainly depends on irrigation water sources and mountain ice-snow meltwater. The question only asks the main limiting condition for agricultural development in region D, so the main limiting factor is water source conditions.
